creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-10-01: "shortcut for renaming tab or pane". Clarified 2026-10-03: did not know `rename_pane` is `cmd+shift+n`; wants the tab version.

`rename_tab` ships unbound by an earlier deliberate choice (docs/configuration.md: "you name a tab once and a pane several times an hour"); amterp reverses it. Pick a chord that collides with nothing Ghostty or macOS uses, and update the paragraph in configuration.md that argued for leaving it unbound.

He also asked for a way to discover shortcuts: `show_shortcuts` (`cmd+/`, "muster Shortcuts" in the menu) already exists. Worth checking it lists both rename chords, and whether it is findable enough (Help menu?).
title: 🎹 A default chord for renaming a tab
